title: More CVEs published each year, but the same old vulnerabilities drive most breaches
content_md:
Each year, more CVEs are published. Each year, the same old vulnerabilities drive the most breaches. The problem is not discovery; it is prioritization.

via Mastodon https://www.cybersecuritydive.com/spons/more-cves-than-ever-the-same-old-ones-keep-getting-exploited/830366/
exclude_reason: Editorial opinion about CVE prioritization. Not a specific security event.
